description: Free, no payment, no AI. Give a question in any language; get the live radar headlines that contain its words (with outlet and link), a count per radar and the tools to call next. It is a pointer, not an answer and not a forecast. For a worded answer use ask_david (answered on air, not instantly).

question.description: Your question or topic, 3-200 characters, e.g. "what about Hormuz"

name: ask_orb
title: Ask Orb Studio a free question: which live radar headlines and which tools speak to it (Hormuz, China, gas, bitcoin …)
